rule: Consumer selects expectedQueryId. Every exact BuildAction input must appear once with an explicit consumed class. Subject is an actual input; profile and implementation must match the action. A changed class, input, implementation, extension environment or action changes the key.
portableGate: PsQueryPlanBoundStage compares verified host projections of profile/extension/action/pass/query IDs before the existing staged dependency planner. It returns rebuild or validateCandidate only. Unknown, trust-expanding and unassured effect classes cannot produce candidates.
invalidation: applyPassEffects enforces supported profiles and required analyses, retains only explicitly preserved available facts, and discards all facts for trust-expanding/unassured passes. Names/metadata do not constitute preservation evidence or reconstitute live capabilities.
production: All newly observed passes declare v2 effects. The checked builder produces one query per observed BuildAction; archive replay validates full coverage when queries are present. Historical records without queries remain identified as such.
cache: The separate filesystem adapter derives the old action from the verified current query and preserves independent candidate/obligation selection, evidence replay and input-closure gates. Exact action matching is conservative; changed-input reuse needs a new checked execution and is not obtained by relabelling an old record.
remaining: connect portable planner projections to a persistent live compiler-service query store
per-module public/structural/behavioral fingerprint producers and adequacy validators
incremental update scheduling beyond conservative exact action reuse
